scene: Tuesday 10:12 to 10:15, the restock window. One customer scrolling Garden by price while merchandising works in the same eighty products: a promotion goes live just ahead of where she has reached, the stock count on the product at the edge is refreshed without changing its price, a line she has already been shown sells out, another she has not reached yet gets a stock update without changing its price, a product is restocked at exactly the price she had just scrolled past, and a second promotion goes on at the cheap end at the wrong price and is pulled again a few screens later.
